kjv: impose, be instant, (be) laid (there-, up-)on, (when) lay (on), lie (on), press upon

occurrences.text: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,

And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared, and no small tempest lay on us, all hope that we should be saved was then taken away.
